subject.title: feat: show Codex sessions across Gateway and paired nodes

question: Should the federated Codex session catalog ship with page-local title search and the proposed cross-node metadata boundary, or must it implement bounded title-only scanning plus explicit security sign-off first?
rationale: The PR crosses paired-node trust boundaries and upstream Codex search can match preview text, so automation should not choose the permanent privacy/performance contract or accept the operator-facing search semantics by itself.

options.title: Require bounded title-only search
options.body: Fix TypeScript and native macOS to scan enough App Server pages for title-only matches while keeping transcript-derived preview matches excluded, then approve the metadata boundary before merge.

options.title: Accept page-local search
options.body: Maintainers can accept the current behavior only if CLI/UI/docs clearly treat search as page-local continuation and the security boundary is approved as-is.

options.title: Pause the catalog direction
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers decide the linked feature should wait for a different Codex/node transport or product boundary.

recommendation.title: Require bounded title-only search
recommendation.body: Fix TypeScript and native macOS to scan enough App Server pages for title-only matches while keeping transcript-derived preview matches excluded, then approve the metadata boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked product request and has the strongest recent history across codex-supervisor and Control UI plugin surfaces.
